preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 100000 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[0] if c.isdigit() and len(line.split()) > 1])]
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(a)) == len(a) and all(1 <= x <= n for x in a) for a in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) > 1 and not line.split()[0].isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each permutation consists of n distinct integers between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum([int(line) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and len(line.split()) == 1 and line.split()[0].isdigit()]) <= 100000
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == sum([1 + k for k in [int(output_lines[i]) for i in range(0, len(output_lines), 1) if i % 2 == 0 and i < len(output_lines) and output_lines[i].strip().isdigit()]] )
postconditions.description: The output format consists of k followed by k lines for each test case, where k is the number of subsequences.

postconditions.expression: all(all(x in original_permutation for x in subseq) and len(subseq) == len(set(subseq)) for subseq in [list(map(int, line.split()[1:])) for line in output_lines if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()])
postconditions.description: Every element in every output subsequence belongs to the original permutation and appears exactly once across all subsequences.

postconditions.expression: all(all(subseq[i] < subseq[i+1] for i in range(len(subseq)-1)) or all(subseq[i] > subseq[i+1] for i in range(len(subseq)-1)) for subseq in [list(map(int, line.split()[1:])) for line in output_lines if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()])
postconditions.description: Each subsequence is strictly monotonic (either strictly increasing or strictly decreasing).

postconditions.expression: all(subseq[i] < subseq[i+1] for i in range(len(subseq)-1)) or all(subseq[i] > subseq[i+1] for i in range(len(subseq)-1))
postconditions.description: The order of elements in each subsequence matches their relative order in the original permutation.

postconditions.expression: len([x for subseq in [list(map(int, line.split()[1:])) for line in output_lines if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdigit()] for x in subseq]) == n
postconditions.description: The total number of elements across all subsequences equals n.
